Air travel is served by the Eugene Airport, also known as Mahlon Sweet Field, which is the fifth largest airport in the Pacific Northwest and second largest airport in Oregon. The Eugene Metro area also has numerous private airports. The Eugene Metro area also has several heliports, such as the Sacred Heart Medical Center Heliport and Mahlon Sweet Field Heliport, and many single helipads.
